senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָדַשׁ)holy, sacred; holy man, saint.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 20a:13">Yeb. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>כל המקיים … נקרא ק׳</he> he who observes the ordinances of the scholars (with regard to marriage laws) is called holy (chaste).

<cite ref="Yevamot 105b:7">Ib. 105ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 27b:23">Meg. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>עם ק׳</he> the holy assembly, v. <cite ref="Q01341"><he>פָּסַע</he></cite>; (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7b:12">Snh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>עם קוֹרֶשׁ</he>; Yeb. l. c. also <he>עם קֹדֶשׁ</he>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:4">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> <he>כשם שאני ק׳ כך וכ׳</he> as I am holy, so be you holy.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:1:7">Y. Sabb. XVI, 15ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 16:12">Treat. Sof’rim XVI, 12</cite> <he>הללו אל בקדשו לקְדוֹשׁוֹ לאהרן קְדוֹשׁ ד׳</he> ‘praise the Lord in his holiness’ (<cite ref="Psalms 150:1">Ps. CL, 1</cite>) according to his holy servant, according to (the years of life of) Aaron, the holy servant of the Lord (123 Hallelujahs).

<cite ref="Temurah 14b:20">Tem. 14ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כל הקרב ביום אינו ק׳ אלא ביום וכ׳</he> whatever must be offered in day-time, becomes sacred (by being put in a sacred vessel) only in day-time &c.

<cite ref="Megillah 23b:15">Meg. 23ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 15a:8">Snh. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>אדם מי ק׳</he> is a human being ever sacred (dedicated to be Temple property)? <cite ref="Berakhot 10b:24">Ber. 10ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Kings 4:9">II Kings IV, 9</cite>) <he>הוא ק׳ … אינו ק׳</he> he (the prophet) is a pure man, but his servant (Gehazi) is not; a. v. fr.—<he>רבינו הק׳</he> our teacher, the saint, i.e. R. Judah Hannasi.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:2:5">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>הק׳ ברוך הוא</he> (abbrev. <he>הקב״ה</he>, <he>הב״ה</he>, <he>הק״ה</he>) the Holy One, blessed be He, the Lord.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>קְדוֹשִׁים</he>. Lev. R. l. c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 86a:7">Sabb. 86ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ישראל ק׳ הן</he> the Israelites are a chaste people.

Pes. 104ᵃ בנן של ק׳ the descendant of holy men (R. Menaḥem); Ab. Zar. 50ᵃ; a. fr.—פרשת ק׳ the section of the Torah beginning with ḳ’doshim (Lev. XIX). Lev. R. l. c.; a. e.—Fem. קְדוֹשָׁה. Y. Maas. Sh. II, end, 53ᵈ; a. e., v. עֵדָה.

senses.gloss: (v. קְדוּשָּׁה) Ḳadosh, the recitation of Ḳadosh (Is. VI, 3). Treat. Sof’rim l. c. קטן … ק׳ ביוצר (not כיוצא) a minor … must not recite Ḳadosh in the morning prayer (v. יָצַר). Ib. ק׳ של עמידה the Ḳadosh recited in the ‘standing prayer’ (v. עֲמִידָה), the Ḳ’dushshah
